Administrative Services

Institutional Quality Assurance Cell

Room: 219, Floor: 1, Building: 2, BUBT Main Campus

About the Office

The Institutional Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC) at BUBT is responsible for promoting and sustaining quality in academic and administrative activities. It develops and monitors quality assurance policies, coordinates self-assessment processes, and ensures continuous improvement in teaching, learning, research, and governance in alignment with national and international standards.
4500+
Students Served
24 Hrs
Processing Time
6
Staff Members
90%
Accuracy Rate

Services of Our Office

Quality Assurance & Enhancement:

Developing and implementing quality benchmarks for all academic and administrative activities in the university.

Academic Audit:

Conducting periodic internal and external audits of academic programs to ensure standards are met and improved upon.

Feedback Mechanism

Facilitating the collection and analysis of feedback from students, faculty, staff, alumni, and employers to inform quality improvement initiatives.

Accreditation Support

Guiding and supporting academic programs in preparing for national and international accreditation and ranking.

Capacity Building

Organizing workshops, seminars, and training programs for faculty and staff on quality assurance, curriculum development, and modern pedagogical techniques.

Documentation & Reporting

Preparing the Annual Quality Assurance Report (AQAR) and other necessary documentation for regulatory bodies like the UGC, BAC.
